text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while after the New Year began.
I bumped into Ryoka Tsurugi and her partner Sonon Elfie
on the street.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Active in the entertainment industry, they had been swamped all through the New Year holidays, and only now finally managed to get a proper break.
choice_data_list: Good work today...! Are you heading out?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Yes. The New Year holiday period has already passed, so it doesn't quite feel like a proper 'first shrine visit of the year' anymore, but—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Even so, we talked about how we still wanted
to do something festive for the New Year!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! If you'd like,
would you care to join us?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And thus, the three of us arrived at――!

text_block_list.name: Barker Lady
text_block_list.text: Come on in, have a drink~! We've got an extraordinary new batch made especially for today's "New Year Sake Fair"!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Oooohh!! *sniff* *sniff* *sniff*...
It has this aroma that feels so soothing and warm inside!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I believe that might be the scent of cooked rice, wouldn't you say?
Mmm... Wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, I ended up dragging you into this,
but you didn't mind, did you?
choice_data_list: No! Not at all, it's not like I dislike it……!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Awesomeee!! Ah, by the way, I'm of legal age!
So I can totally drink! Let's enjoy it together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Well then, shall we head out right away?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At this festival, purchasing an entry ticket granted two full hours of all-you-can-drink Japanese sake across various tasting booths!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Phew-haah! This is... quite something...!
Like, whoa, this really hits the spot!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if this is too dry for Elfie?
That sparkling sake over there might be easier for her to drink.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: How does that sound to you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Y-Yeah, I don't really know much about it...!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'd be delighted if we could find something you like together.
—Shall we check out some other spots?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's go, let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them walked with light, cheerful steps.
With a rare day off and an event full of New Year's spirit, their hearts were practically dancing――
choice_data_list: Alright... to make sure both of them have even more fun――!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I resolved to keep a level head
so it wouldn't matter if they let loose
and got thoroughly drunk...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...However.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Tsurugi-san, Tsurugi-san!! This is delicious! Isn't it just?!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!!
Hehe, ahaha, ahahaaa♪

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Quite so. Though Elfie,
perhaps it's about time you switched to water.
choice_data_list: Ah, in that case, I'll go get it!
Ah, in that case, I'll go get it!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you sure?
, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I managed to lend a hand to Sonon Elfie,
whose situation was rapidly turning rather amusing.
...Everything was fine up to that point.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Whew, my heart finally stopped pounding so hard!
I'll stick to water from here on out.
Don't let me hold you back, Tsurugi-san, enjoy yourselves!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Elfie.
Trainer, are you still holding up okay?
choice_data_list: Yes, I've still got plenty of energy!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, wonderful!
Now then, let's head toward that blue cocktail over there――

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, it's so fruity...!
You could easily gulp this down in no time.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
This rich, full-bodied flavor...
makes me want to savor it slowly.
What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed, this really is best enjoyed warm...!
The aroma becomes even more brilliant――

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
And... oh? Trainer?
...T-Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer...!!
Thank goodness, you've come to.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...I am terribly sorry.
You were so wonderful at keeping the energy up that I completely lost track of time and dragged you along...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry!
Please, take all the time you need to rest.
choice_data_list: No! I'm the one who caused you trouble……!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Um... I know I made you push yourself,
but I had a lot of fun spending time together.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
If you don't hold this against me and give me another chance...
I would be overjoyed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, I must never let myself be swept into Ryoka Tsurugi's pace...
I made a firm vow to myself.
